name: Susan
source:
She works as an underpaid freelance writer and has been down in the dumps lately, because she hasn't gotten any decent jobs for quite a while. Susan is passionate about writing and is generally a serious person. However, despite her professional nature she may or may not secretly be a little crazy. Susan has a hard time making friends, because she has some self-esteem issues that affect her personal life. Due to the nature of her job, she developed a habit of incessantly asking questions regardless of whether she is on or off duty.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=23120]Lemma Soft WIP Thread[/url]]
